_comment: WO-430 tiers + WO-432 tech-tree, perks re-authored to the owner's icon taxonomy (2026-06-20). Per building: tiers 1-4 (cost + cumulative GameModifiers + requiresVillageTier gate) + perks[] (Gold-cost research, unlocked AT a tier; iconId = a sprite in Resources/HudIcons/BuildingUpgrades/<iconId>.jpg; isSignature = the gilt T3 capstone). v4 (2026-07-02, perk-grid redo): every tier + perk carries a one-line concrete 'effect' string the panel renders on its tile (owner directive: player sees WHAT the enhancement does). v5 (2026-07-17, STRUCTURE-HP-per-tier, owner 'buildings don't change visually, they just unlock perks and maybe add more HP'): each tier carries a machine-readable 'structureHpBonusPct' (CUMULATIVE-ABSOLUTE fraction over the building's base max HP at that tier; owner-tunable) that the generic HP applier (ModifierService.StructureHpMultFor -> Building.ApplyStructureHpMultiplier) uses to raise the building's real max HP; the SAME value is ALSO appended to the tier 'effect' string as a plain 'Structure HP +N%' clause so the upgrade panel (BuildingUpgradeVM.EffectFor -> tier.Effect) shows it with no panel/VM edit. Owner mapping: Blacksmith = the armorer building; Barracks is a NEW building (troops); windmill keeps tiers, no perks. Icons are the existing <Building>_T1_<Perk> files. Mirror in StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical/. WO-861 (2026-08-02): the arcane-tower rows are now the CATHEDRAL OF MAGIC - Thrain's leveling building; its tier/perk modifiers were re-pointed from tower stats to MAGE stats + unlockSpell (see that building's _comment for the silently-dropped-key + tower-balance flags). WO-855 Phase 5 (2026-08-03, gather-faucet balance): the LUMBERMILL wood-production stack was the only production ladder breaching WO-855 section 4.8's 'cap stacked mults at +50-80% over base from perks alone'. ModifierService.Compute multiplies the CURRENT tier def by EVERY owned perk, so a maxed mill compounded tier T4 1.50 x perks 1.08 x 1.15 x 1.10 = x2.05 (+105%). Tier ladder rescaled 1.12/1.20/1.35/1.50 -> 1.10/1.18/1.28/1.40 and perks 1.08/1.15/1.10 -> 1.06/1.10/1.08, giving a max stack of 1.40 x 1.06 x 1.10 x 1.08 = x1.763 (+76.3%), inside the band. The 'effect' strings were rewritten in the same edit so the upgrade panel never advertises a percentage the modifier no longer grants. The other two production ladders were MEASURED and left alone: forge resourceEfficiencyMult maxes at 1.22 x 1.08 x 1.15 = x1.515 (+51.5%) and windmill foodProductionMult at x1.45 (+45%), both already inside the band. Guarded by BuildingUpgradeRegression case 7 [gather-faucet], which walks EVERY building's tier x perk product for every *ProductionMult / resourceEfficiencyMult key. v6 (2026-08-08, ladder-vs-nameplate name parity): the ladder row for id 'forge' read displayName 'Forge' while structures-catalog.json + buildings.json (canon-strings key 'forge') both resolved that SAME id to 'Armorer' - so one building read 'Forge' on the upgrade screen and 'Armorer' on its nameplate. The LADDER was corrected to the nameplate, not the reverse. STOP: v7 (2026-08-23, WO-1161 follow-up - THE v6 CORRECTION WAS APPLIED IN THE WRONG DIRECTION AND IS HEREBY REVERSED): v6 recorded a WO-840 ruling that 'the naming is inverted on purpose' (catalog id 'workshop' = the weapons shop 'Forge', catalog id 'forge' = the armor shop 'Armorer', catalog id 'armorer' = 'Blacksmith'). WARNING: THAT INVERSION IS RETIRED. WO-1161 straightened the names AT THE CATALOG (structures-catalog.json v25) from vendors.json - what a building DOES is the authority: id 'forge' SELLS WEAPONS so it displays 'Forge'; id 'armorer' SELLS ARMOUR so it displays 'Armorer'; id 'workshop' is NOT a vendor at all so it displays 'Crafting Station'. structures-catalog.json is now the SINGLE naming authority and this ladder follows it: 'forge' Armorer -> Forge, 'armorer' Blacksmith -> Armorer. Do NOT re-cross these to match a doc; if a name must move, move it in structures-catalog.json and let this file follow. IDS ARE FROZEN SAVE KEYS (BuildingTiers is keyed by them) - only displayName moved. NOTE: with the names straightened the tier FLAVOR now reads correctly by accident of the fix - the smelting ladder ('Ignite the Forge' / 'Improved Smelting' / 'Master Metallurgy' / 'Forgefire') sits under a 'Forge' header, and the armour ladder's troopHealth/troopDamage kit sits under 'Armorer'. Its tier NAME 'Open the Blacksmith' and its 'blacksmith-*' perk ids are the one remaining mismatch: the perk ids are PERSISTED research keys and must never be renamed; the tier name is player-facing flavor and is left for an owner creative call. v8 (2026-09-10, WO-1657 item A, owner ruling 12:12): EVERY tier row in this file now authors costGold 0. WO-947 (regular structures cost wood + iron; crystals are the magical basket) governs the UPGRADE ladder too, not just placement - the owner saw a Gold term on a Quarry upgrade and ruled it out. The gold VALUES were deleted, not moved: the charged basket is unchanged because BuildingTierChargeLane already derives the spent resource from the TIER NUMBER over BuildingTierDef.PrimaryMaterialCost = Max(costWood, costCrystal) (owner ruling 22, WO-2005), so zeroing costGold removes the Coins term and nothing else. The screens self-omit a zero part - CostFormat.Parts skips amount <= 0 (CostFormat.cs:32-34) and BuildingUpgradeVM.AddCoinCostLine returns on amount <= 0 (:1545-1547) - so no empty Gold chip renders. Pinned by BuildingUpgradeRegression [shortfall-named][gold-line], which was RE-POINTED (not deleted) from -the VM still emits a gold line- to -no tier authors costGold- and walks BOTH canonical twins. PERK goldCost is RESEARCH and is deliberately UNTOUCHED - different key, different ruling. Do NOT re-price a ladder tier in gold.

buildings._comment: WO-861 A3 (owner-approved 2026-08-02)  -  this is THRAIN'S LEVELING BUILDING, not a defence. Its tier perks were re-pointed from TOWER stats (towerDamageMult / towerRangeMult / arcaneOverload) to MAGE stats + learnable SPELLS. Do NOT confuse it with the DEFENSIVE 'Arcane Spire' (tower_arcane_spire, behaviorId ArcaneTower)  -  Spire = defending, Cathedral = leveling. displayName now matches structures-catalog.json ('Cathedral of Magic'). NEW perk keys  -  mageSpellPowerMult / mageManaMax (ADDITIVE integer, not a mult) / mageManaRegenMult / mageHpBonusPct / mageShellStrengthMult / mageManaCostMult / unlockSpell (comma-separated abilities.json ids)  -  are LIVE as of WO-861 Phase 3 (re-verified 2026-08-02): GameModifiers carries every one of them, ModifierService.Apply aggregates them BY KIND (the four mults compound, mageManaMax + mageHpBonusPct add, unlockSpell UNIONS its comma list) and HeroTalentModifiers -> HeroAbilities consume them, so an authored value is felt rather than silently dropped. The earlier 'Newtonsoft SILENTLY DROPS these' note in this comment is SUPERSEDED and was stale. CUMULATIVE-ABSOLUTE IS LAW FOR EVERY TIER LADDER IN THIS FILE (defect found + fixed 2026-08-02): ModifierService.Compute applies ONLY BuildingTierCatalog.TierOf(id, currentTier) - ONE tier def, never a sum over the tiers beneath it - so EVERY tier must RESTATE the full kit of every tier below it, both keys AND unlockSpell ids. The union in Apply merges across CONTRIBUTORS (tier + perks + other buildings), NOT across tiers of the same building, so this cannot be fixed in code. Before the fix the mage rows were per-tier DELTAS: T2 dropped spellPower, T3 dropped mana+spellPower+frost-nova, and T4 dropped mana/hp/shell AND all three earlier spells - a fully-upgraded Cathedral was strictly WORSE than tier 3 (it traded Frost Nova + Manaweave + Arcane Bolt for Cataclysm). The tower keys were already authored correctly (T3 and T4 both restate towerDamageMult + towerRangeMult) and are the template. Guarded by CathedralCumulativeRegression [cathedral-cumulative], which enforces the rule for EVERY building in this file. BALANCE HOLE FOUND AND CLOSED (owner: 'fix the tower research ladder', 2026-08-02): re-pointing this building to mage stats left NOTHING in the entire catalog granting towerDamageMult / towerRangeMult / arcaneOverload, so every defensive tower silently lost its village-wide research buff. The tower keys are RESTORED here ALONGSIDE the mage keys - the Cathedral of Magic now powers BOTH Thrain AND the realm's arcane defences, which is thematically coherent and, more importantly, is the only place that actually WORKS: the tier ladder is consumed per building id, and only 6 buildings have blocks (arcane-tower, armorer, barracks, forge, lumbermill, windmill). tower_arcane_spire ('Arcane Spire', a real buildable Tower costing 80 crystals) has NO block, so authoring one there would have produced data with no consumer - the same silent-drop failure the mage keys have until Phase 3. NOTE the two ladders are independent: tower-perks.json is the PER-TOWER tier table (WO-432) every placed tower applies to itself and was never affected; these keys are the GLOBAL multiplier ArcaneTower.EffectiveDamage/EffectiveRange read off ModifierService.Active. Values restored verbatim from the pre-re-point ladder (T1 dmg 1.05 / T2 1.08 / T3 1.18+range 1.12 / T4 1.18+1.12+arcaneOverload).
